messages:
maya (partnerships): Quick sync — AWS/GCP/Azure listing onboarding. Found mismatch between trial SKU and billing SKU for 'Redwood Dedicated - Starter' when publisher portal ingest runs. Need owner + fix + confirm if we should alias on manifest. Anyone on call?
liam (product): Is this the SKU that was renamed in Q3? If so prefer canonical sku_id=rw-ded-starter-v2. We can keep alias mapping in the manifest. @alex can we support alias resolution in ingestion to avoid rollout hiccups?
alex (eng-infra): We can. Plan: ingest lambda reads an `aliases` array and maps to canonical sku. Quick patch, ~1-2d. Need test manifests for each cloud (aws/gcp/azure).
deepa (legal): Heads up — rename may require updating EULA URL and localized terms if packaging changes. If aliasing only in manifest, that's fine. If billing contract or price changes, need sign-off. Ping me with final sku_id.
sam (cloud-ops): Publisher portal notes: I can add role for `pub-ingest` service account for AWS/GCP. For Azure, we need publisher tenant admin to grant contributor. Also FYI Azure uses an `offerId` that must match SKU mapping.
jen (pubops): Timeline check — customer launch next Tue. We need ingestion fix + manifest deploy by Fri. I'll coordinate with publisher. @maya can you confirm who will create test manifests?
maya (partnerships): I'll create test manifests for AWS/GCP/Azure by EOD tomorrow. @alex please add a small unit test harness. @sam I'll need the publisher service account creds — can you send?
marketplace-bot: New ticket PM-4921 created: "manifest aliasing support + SKU normalization" — assignees: alex, maya
alex (eng-infra): Got the ticket. I'll sketch PR today; aim to land by Thu if no blockers.
liam (product): Product ask: when alias present, do we display canonical product name in storefront and keep old SKU as a redirect? Prefer redirect so no purchase breaks.
deepa (legal): Redirect OK as long as terms are identical and we notify customers if price/terms change.
maya (partnerships): Action items: maya create test manifests (due: tomorrow), alex implement alias mapping (PR by Thu), sam obtain publisher creds (today), jen coordinate publish window (Fri). I'll update PM-4921.
jen (pubops): Also double-check trial entitlement mapping — some merchants treat trial as separate SKU, need mapping to entitlement `trial-30d`.
alex (eng-infra): Adding entitlement mapping support in manifest schema. Proposed sample YAML to validate ingestion: ```
sku: rw-ded-starter-v2
aliases: [rw-ded-starter, rw-ded-starter-old]
entitlements: [trial-30d]
```
maya (partnerships): Sample looks good. Also can we add a smoke check in ingest pipeline to require `eula_url`? Saw one manifest missing it earlier.
deepa (legal): Yes — require non-empty `eula_url` for public listings. Add to checklist.
sam (cloud-ops): Sending service account request to publisher now. cc: @maya
marketplace-bot: Ticket PM-4921 status updated -> in progress (alex)
maya (partnerships): Thanks all. I'll follow up in PM-4921 with test manifests and a short checklist. Meeting adjourned. :thumbsup:
